narrative: 这个镜头用来强调一次打击、一个名字、一件武器，或一个喜剧包袱。人为的痕迹本身就是要点。
观众不是被邀请走近，而是被镜头猛然击中。对于一个需要用几秒钟慢慢落定的想法，或是对于展示空间关系，这都是错误的工具。
急推之后要定住画面。如果继续变焦或加入抖动，这个“打击感”就会变成噪音。
how: 让主体始终位于变焦中心。使用可控的快速变焦，或在后期用高分辨率裁切来模拟光学变焦的效果，而不是产生扭曲变形。
急推过程中应出现放射状运动模糊，之后紧紧定住这个近景画面。避免自动对焦“抽风”式来回搜索。
提示词中要求一秒钟以内的猛烈光学推近、变焦模糊，然后是锁定的近景定格，并明确排除物理推轨（Dolly）。
when: 用它来强调一次打击、一次顿悟，或一个喜剧包袱。具体场景：一个名字被说出的瞬间，画面猛然推近到面部特写。
不要用它替代摄影机穿过房间、逐渐走近的过程。
vs: 慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）是同一光学家族在耐心速度下的表现。推轨推进（Dolly In）则带有视差，感觉像是一个人正在走近。
甩镜头（Whip Pan）的模糊来自云台的快速旋转，而不是焦距的变化。急推变焦则是镜头的一次猛推，然后定格。
examples_film: 《被解救的姜戈》（Django Unchained）用突然的变焦作为西部片式的强调手法。《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）用急推来快速给出喜剧信息。
《杀死比尔》（Kill Bill）和《热血警探》（Hot Fuzz）都把急推变焦当作类型片的语法，而不是追求隐形剪辑。要学习的是那种速度和定格，而不是表面的风格外壳。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是快速的推轨推进（Dolly In）或甩镜头（Whip Pan）。破绽在于出现了视差或水平拖影，而不是放射状的变焦模糊。
修正方法：机身保持静止，主体居中，猛然一推，然后定住近景画面。不要加入无关的镜头抖动。

faq.q: 电影中的“急推变焦”是什么？
faq.a: 这是焦距的极速增大，通常在机身锁定的状态下，从一个较宽的镜头猛然推近到某个细节，然后定住画面。

faq.q: 急推变焦 与 推轨推进 的区别
faq.a: 推轨推进是摄影机在空间中的移动。急推变焦只改变镜头焦距，通常伴随放射状模糊，读起来像是一个标点符号，而不是一次靠近的过程。

faq.q: 什么时候该使用急推变焦？
faq.a: 当某个事实必须猛然击中观众时使用：一张脸、一把枪、一个片名、一个笑点。每个节拍只用一次，并保持定格。不要用它来游览场景。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写急推变焦的提示词？
faq.a: 要求一秒以内的猛推光学变焦、放射状变焦模糊、静止的机身，以及明确的定格。排除推轨和额外的抖动。

narrative: The shot punctuates a hit, a name, a weapon, or a comic sting. Artificiality is the point.
The audience is not invited to approach; they are struck by a lens. It is the wrong tool for a thought that should land over several seconds, and the wrong tool for geography.
After the snap, hold. If you keep zooming or add shake, the sting becomes noise.
how: Keep the subject on the zoom center. Use a controlled fast zoom or, in post, a high-resolution crop that still behaves like optics, not a warp.
Expect radial motion blur during the snap, then a hard hold on the tight frame. Avoid autofocus hunting.
Prompt an aggressive optical punch-in under one second, zoom blur, then a locked tight hold, and ban a physical dolly.
when: Use it to punctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Concrete beat: a name is spoken and the face slams into close-up.
Do not use it as a substitute for walking closer through a room.
vs: A Slow Zoom In is the same optical family at patience speed. A Dolly In has parallax and feels like a person stepping in.
A Whip Pan blurs by rotating the head, not by changing focal length. Crash zoom in is a snap of the lens, then a hold.
examples_film: Django Unchained uses abrupt zooms as Western punctuation. The Grand Budapest Hotel snaps to comic information.
Kill Bill and Hot Fuzz treat the crash zoom as genre grammar rather than invisibility. Use the speed and the hold, not the costumes.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a fast Dolly In or a Whip Pan. The tell is parallax or horizontal streaking instead of radial zoom blur.
The fix: camera body still, subject on center, snap, then freeze the tight frame. Do not add unrelated camera shake.

faq.q: What is Crash Zoom In in film?
faq.a: It is a very fast increase of focal length that slams from a wider shot into a detail, usually from a locked camera, then holds.

faq.q: Crash Zoom In vs Dolly In
faq.a: Dolly in moves the camera through space. Crash zoom in changes only the lens, often with radial blur, and reads as a punctuation mark rather than an approach.

faq.q: When should I use Crash Zoom In?
faq.a: When a fact must hit: a face, a gun, a title, a joke. Use it once per beat and hold. Do not use it to tour a location.

faq.q: How do I prompt Crash Zoom In for AI image or video?
faq.a: Demand a snap optical zoom in under one second, radial zoom blur, a still camera body, and a hard hold. Ban dolly and extra shake.
